# EEP 9999 - A fixture that passes every check

## Abstract

The known-good fixture. Every other file in this directory is this one
with a single rule broken, so that each rule is seen failing on its own
before it is trusted to pass.

## Motivation

A checker nobody has watched fail is a checker nobody has tested.

## Specification

This document conforms to every rule `tools/check-eeps` enforces. When it
stops doing so, a rule has changed and the fixtures need regenerating.

## Rationale

Holding the baseline in a file, rather than in the checker's own tests,
lets a reader see what a conforming EEP looks like without running
anything.

## How to teach this

Read this file. Then read one of its broken siblings and the rule it is
named for.

## Reference implementation

The first EEP written from the template without an editor's corrections.

## Rejected ideas

- Generating the fixtures at test time. A reviewer could not then read
  them in the diff.

## Open issues

None.
